bot.name: Marine Hell
bot.description: A simple Terran bot that gathers a large Marine army before attacking. Human difficulty is not yet calibrated.

formats.notes: Local Terran games on Fighting Spirit with x86 and x64 SC:R; x64 bunker adapter verified. See release review for exact versions and boundaries.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: No persistence or learning API in the single-file bot source.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: MIT source and patched source included; JBWAPI/Java BWEM MIT, JNA Apache-2.0 option, and embedded libffi MIT notices included.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped source, dependency notice, archived source rebuild and local gameplay review: https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/marine-hell-sb-4/docs/marine-hell-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Track separately from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Partial BWAPI semantics; legacy unit limits required.
Java 21 x64 required, including with x86 SC:R.
Terran 1v1 tested on Fighting Spirit; other maps and formats are unverified.
Bunker entry uses a source adapter to native right-click; general BWAPI Load is not supported.
Human skill has not been calibrated.

sourceReview.evidence: Source and artifact effects reviewed; independent archive audit, local x86/x64 games and corrected bunker occupancy verified. Not an OS sandbox certification. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/marine-hell-sb-4/docs/marine-hell-admission.md
